name: 75251 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75251 (Dallas) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75251 (Dallas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75251 (Dallas) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
